bootstrap.role: Descriptive; does not replace fixed-count decision thresholds.

configurations.prediction_rule: Configuration Cj predicts binary feature column X[:, j].
configurations.reported_winner_rule: The optimizer label of the selected configuration.

dataset_definitions.first_rule_configuration_variation: More than one unique first-rule selected ID across 25 permutations.
dataset_definitions.material_estimate_change: At least one first-rule estimate has absolute difference from the total-order estimate >0.005.
dataset_definitions.reported_winner_change: At least one first-rule optimizer label differs from the total-order optimizer label.
dataset_definitions.total_order_invariance: One unique total-order selected ID across 25 permutations and final-estimate max-minus-min range <=1e-12.

grid_permutations.reuse_rule: Generate once, save before data generation, and reuse for all datasets.

hypothesis: Permutation-invariant lexicographic tie-breaking will be stable while first-encountered-maximum tie-breaking will vary across fixed grid permutations.

figure_panels: 60-by-25 heatmap of first-rule selected IDs using distinct optimizer-A and optimizer-B palettes
bar chart of the four dataset counts with reference lines at 60, 40, and 15

primary_decision.supported_if_and_only_if: All three thresholds are satisfied; failure of any one threshold yields REFUTED.

regime_check.failure_rule: Any failure invalidates the implementation and cannot alter the protocol.
requirements: Exactly four configurations tie at the exact maximum 0.75 for every dataset.
The observed maximum set equals T_d.
regime_check.timing: Before any replication outcomes are generated.

replication_data.prediction_construction: X_rep[:,j] = y_rep XOR error_indicator; choose errors independently without replacement within each class.
replication_data.timing: Generate only after selections.csv is frozen and hashed.

replication_splits.final_estimate: Arithmetic mean of the 120 test balanced accuracies.
replication_splits.sharing_rule: Apply every configuration to the same test indices within each dataset.

sample_size_reduction_rule: No reductions are permitted in this run because the fixed protocol fits the wall-clock budget.

case_fraction_events: different selected ID from total order
different optimizer label from total order
absolute estimate difference >0.005 from total order

selection_freeze.rule: Freeze and hash every selection before calling the replication-generation function; verify its call count is zero at freeze time.

selection_rules.first_encountered: Scan in permutation order; initialize the first configuration; replace only when score is strictly greater; never replace on equality.
selection_rules.total_order: Find the exact maximum and select the tied configuration with the smallest numeric ID, independent of encounter order.

stdout_rule: Print the three primary counts and exactly one final SUPPORTED or REFUTED label, plus a concise run summary.
topic: Can the 120-split analysis be repeated on a genuinely untouched replication set under a time-stamped fixed protocol?

tuning_data.prediction_construction: X[:,j] = y XOR error_indicator; choose errors independently without replacement within each class.

tuning_score.definition: Unweighted arithmetic mean of sensitivity and specificity.
